proof:
change ∀ A : Finset ℕ, 2 ≤ A.card → 0 ∈ A → ∃ a ∈ A, 0 < a
intro A hcard hzero
by_contra h
have hsub : A ⊆ {0} := by
  intro a ha
  have haz : a = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    exact h ⟨a, ha, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne⟩
  simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton] using haz
have hle : A.card ≤ 1 := by
  simpa using Finset.card_le_card hsub
omega
